package main

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"

	workpb "example.com/admission/gen/grpc/work/pb"
	grpcserver "example.com/admission/gen/grpc/work/server"
	httpserver "example.com/admission/gen/http/work/server"
	"example.com/admission/gen/work"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/admission"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/metadata"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

type testService struct {
	workService
	finish   <-chan struct{}
	calls    int
	checks   int
	deny     bool
	deadline time.Time
}

func (s *testService) Run(ctx context.Context, _ *work.RunPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	if ctx.Value(actorKey{}) != true {
		return "", loom.Fault("authenticated context lost")
	}
	s.deadline, _ = ctx.Deadline()
	<-s.finish
	return "done", nil
}

func (s *testService) AuthorizeWorkRun(ctx context.Context) error {
	s.checks++
	if s.deny {
		return loom.PermanentError("forbidden", "work permission denied")
	}
	return s.workService.AuthorizeWorkRun(ctx)
}

func TestGeneratedAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		budget, err := admission.NewConcurrency(1)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		finish := make(chan struct{})
		unblock := sync.OnceFunc(func() {
			close(finish)
		})
		defer unblock()
		service := &testService{workService: workService{key: "valid"}, finish: finish}
		endpoints := work.NewEndpoints(service, service)
		endpoints.Use(budget.Middleware)
		mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
		httpserver.Mount(mux, httpserver.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
		request := func(key, body string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/work", strings.NewReader(body))
			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			req.Header.Set("X-API-Key", key)
			recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(recorder, req)
			return recorder
		}
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Minute)
		defer cancel()
		go func() {
			result, err := endpoints.Run(ctx, &work.RunPayload{Key: "valid", Seconds: 1})
			assert.NoError(t, err)
			assert.Equal(t, "done", result)
		}()
		synctest.Wait()
		deadline, ok := ctx.Deadline()
		require.True(t, ok)
		require.Equal(t, deadline, service.deadline)
		require.GreaterOrEqual(t, service.checks, 2, "access is checked before admission and again before service")
		cancel()
		synctest.Wait()
		require.Equal(t, 1, budget.Snapshot().InFlight)
		for _, tc := range []struct {
			name, key, body string
			status          int
			deny            bool
		}{
			{"saturated", "valid", "{\"seconds\":1}", 503, false},
			{"invalid", "valid", "{\"seconds\":0}", 400, false},
			{"unauthenticated", "invalid", "{\"seconds\":1}", 401, false},
			{"forbidden", "valid", "{\"seconds\":1}", 403, true},
		} {
			service.deny = tc.deny
			recorder := request(tc.key, tc.body)
			require.Equal(t, tc.status, recorder.Code, "%s: %s", tc.name, recorder.Body.String())
			require.Equal(t, 1, service.calls, tc.name)
			if tc.status == 503 {
				require.Contains(t, recorder.Body.String(), "overloaded")
				require.Contains(t, recorder.Body.String(), "service capacity exhausted")
				require.Empty(t, recorder.Header().Get("Retry-After"))
			}
		}
		service.deny = false
		require.Equal(t, uint64(1), budget.Snapshot().Rejected, "invalid and denied requests never reach the limiter")
		grpc := grpcserver.New(endpoints, nil)
		grpcCtx := metadata.NewIncomingContext(context.Background(), metadata.Pairs("x-api-key", "valid"))
		_, err = grpc.Run(grpcCtx, &workpb.RunRequest{Seconds: proto.Int64(1)})
		require.Equal(t, codes.Unavailable, status.Code(err))
		require.Equal(t, 1, service.calls)
		_, err = endpoints.Run(ctx, &work.RunPayload{Key: "valid", Seconds: 1})
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, context.Canceled)
		require.Equal(t, uint64(2), budget.Snapshot().Rejected)
		unblock()
		synctest.Wait()
		require.Zero(t, budget.Snapshot().InFlight)
		recorder := request("valid", "{\"seconds\":1}")
		require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code, recorder.Body.String())
		require.Equal(t, 2, service.calls)
		require.Equal(t, uint64(2), budget.Snapshot().Admitted)
	})
}

func TestGeneratedChecksRepeatInsidePermit(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mutation := range []string{"payload", "permission", "cancel"} {
		t.Run(mutation, func(t *testing.T) {
			budget, err := admission.NewConcurrency(1)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			finish := make(chan struct{})
			close(finish)
			service := &testService{workService: workService{key: "valid"}, finish: finish}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			defer cancel()
			mutate := func(next loom.Endpoint) loom.Endpoint {
				return func(ctx context.Context, req any) (any, error) {
					switch mutation {
					case "payload":
						req.(*work.RunPayload).Seconds = 0
					case "permission":
						service.deny = true
					case "cancel":
						cancel()
					}
					return next(ctx, req)
				}
			}
			endpoint := work.NewRunEndpoint(service, service, service.APIKeyAuth, mutate, budget.Middleware)
			_, err = endpoint(ctx, &work.RunPayload{Key: "valid", Seconds: 1})
			require.Error(t, err)
			require.Zero(t, service.calls)
			require.Equal(t, admission.ConcurrencySnapshot{Capacity: 1, Admitted: 1}, budget.Snapshot())
		})
	}
}
